items.title: Infineon stock target lowered at BofA on growing AI concerns
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America trimmed its price target on Infineon to €80 from €88, citing ongoing concerns over AI capex financing, monetization and potentially more restrictive data center permits, while reiterating a Buy rating after the chipmaker’s latest guidance.
